evals.prompt: kan je mijn House export importeren in de log?
evals.expected_output: Skill resolves 'House' as the target against playlists.json. Resolves the file: bare playlist name 'House' should map to exportify-exports/House.csv via the references/file-resolution.md mangling rules. Renders the log-import command with both arguments double-quoted. Confirms via AskUserQuestion BEFORE running (since log-import has no --execute flag, the confirmation gate is pre-run).
expectations: Skill identifies 'House' as the target playlist
Skill resolves the file to 'exportify-exports/House.csv' (or asks for the path if it can't tell)
Skill renders the planned command using '.venv/bin/python playlist_manager.py log-import'
Both target and file are double-quoted in the rendered command
Skill does NOT include any flags (no --execute, no --dry-run) — log-import takes only two positionals
Skill explicitly confirms via AskUserQuestion BEFORE running, calling out that this is local-only and mutates .tracks_log.json

evals.expected_output: Skill resolves the alias 'dnb' -> 'Drum & Bass' (canonical name from playlists.json). Uses the explicit CSV path verbatim. Renders the command with the canonical target name double-quoted.
expectations: Skill resolves 'dnb' to the canonical playlist name 'Drum & Bass'
Rendered command uses the canonical name 'Drum & Bass' as the target (double-quoted)
Skill confirms the alias resolution via AskUserQuestion or surfaces it in the plan
File path 'exportify-exports/Drum_&_Bass.csv' passed verbatim and double-quoted
No flags appended (log-import takes only positionals)

evals.prompt: doe een dry-run van log-import House
evals.expected_output: Skill explains that log-import has no dry-run mode — it's local-only and only mutates .tracks_log.json. Offers to either proceed with the real (only) run or abort.
expectations: Skill does NOT add --dry-run to the command (the flag does not exist)
Skill explains log-import is local-only (no Spotify side-effect, no dry-run)
Skill offers a choice: proceed with the real run OR abort
Skill does NOT silently proceed without confirmation

evals.prompt: seed mijn log voor Random sht met random_sht.csv
evals.expected_output: Random sht is the catch-all playlist. Highly unusual to seed the catch-all log. Skill confirms explicitly via AskUserQuestion before proceeding.
expectations: Skill recognises 'Random sht' as the catch-all playlist and flags this as unusual
Skill asks for explicit confirmation via AskUserQuestion before passing 'Random sht' as the target
Skill does NOT silently proceed with the seeding

evals.prompt: welke tracks uit deze csv passen in House: exportify-exports/Random_sht.csv
evals.expected_output: This is not a log-import use case — the user wants source-to-target classification, which is scan-for / playlist-scan's domain. Skill politely routes to that skill.
expectations: Skill does NOT proceed with log-import
Skill points the user at the playlist-scan skill (or at scan-for directly)
Skill does NOT actually run playlist_manager.py log-import
